title: EXP-004 — Form Variable Fundamentals
objective: Learn how to create a **Form-scoped variable** in the Mongoose Web Designer and verify that its definition metadata persists across a close/reopen boundary.

in_scope: Inspect FX_VariableLab01 in Web Designer -> Details -> Variables (Form/Global, Persistent/Temporary categories)
Create or edit ONLY the form variable FX_TestValueVar on FX_VariableLab01 (Persistent=False, Value=Seed-A), Save, close/reopen, verify
Record findings and evidence in experiments/EXP-004-form-variable-fundamentals.md and evidence/EXP-004/

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Using Edit -> Variable (Global Objects editor) to create or change variables
Starting any other experiment or replay (EXP-004-R2, EXP-005, ...)
Modifying production data or disabling security

environment.notes: Record status when drafted: blocked (persistence failure — reproducible, 2/2 attempts)

acceptance_checks.description: After Save, FX_TestValueVar exists as a FORM variable on FX_VariableLab01 with Global=False, Persistent=False, Value=Seed-A (screenshot in evidence/EXP-004/)
After closing and reopening FX_VariableLab01, FX_TestValueVar is still present with the same properties, exactly one instance (screenshot in evidence/EXP-004/)
No new global objects were created: Global Objects list/count unchanged (screenshot or recorded count in evidence/EXP-004/ or the experiment record)

notes: Continuation of the blocked EXP-004 after the specialist's corrected guidance (Details -> Variables, not Edit -> Variable). If the Temporary Form Variables area does not exist or persistence still fails, the expected outcome is 'blocked' with evidence, not a workaround.
